message.description: English rendering of `code`; not for programmatic use.

params.description: Parameters named by the code's documentation. Always present.

path.description: JSON pointer into the configuration input; empty for the document.

freshness.description: Independent of historical result; never implies data-plane health.

phase.description: Last result for the original target, including historical instances.

affectedNodeIds.description:

changedListeners.description: Listeners added, removed or changed, including material to be generated.

identityChangedNodeIds.description: Nodes whose identity or its stable binding changes.

preparedRuleSets.description: Transient canonical content checked by validate; no artifact/version reservation.

requirements.description:

warnings.description: Accepted as written but probably unintended, e.g. a shadowed rule.

willGenerate.description: Values that apply will generate, after rechecking authorization and CAS.

targetCount.description:
Counts of the original targets' last accepted phase, not online/healthy
nodes. Inspect each node's independent freshness before presenting it as
currently applied; expired/superseded results remain historical evidence.

oneOf.description:

select this exact historical publication from the same source version.

Digest.description:
A lossless 32-byte digest represented as exactly 64 lowercase hex digits.

This value does not compute hashes or define their input encoding or purpose.
In particular, serializability does not authorize publication of secret hashes.

egress.description: Proved absence of exit selection only; never permission to open a socket.

profile.description: Regular resolution follows this selection; explicit resolver exceptions retain useWithExit.

VlessStream.description:
Concrete VLESS stream encapsulation. Dialer selection such as `auto` is not
an encapsulation, and neither variant means that its runtime is installed.

WebSocketHeaders.description: Additional WebSocket headers, preserving casing. HTTP token names cannot override Host, Connection, Upgrade, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding or Sec-WebSocket-*, ignoring ASCII case. Handshake and HTTP message framing fields belong to the upgrade implementation. Names must also be unique ignoring ASCII case (semantic validation).

additionalProperties.description:
Header text preserved verbatim, including empty values and horizontal tabs.
CR/LF, NUL and other Unicode control characters (except HTAB) are rejected.
Unicode text is represented as UTF-8; protocol-specific semantic constraints
and request/header size limits remain the consumer's responsibility.

propertyNames.description:
Case-preserving HTTP token for an additional WebSocket header.
Host, Connection, Upgrade, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding, and every
Sec-WebSocket-* name are reserved, ignoring ASCII case. Handshake and HTTP
message framing fields belong to the upgrade implementation. No Unicode
header names are allowed by HTTP token syntax.

WebSocketPath.description:
Exact path, preserved without URL decoding or normalization.
Unicode is permitted, but whitespace, C0/C1 controls, query and fragment
delimiters are not. Percent escapes are not decoded by this value type.

WireSecret.description:
Secret wire string. Serialization and borrowing are explicit; Debug, Display,
and Clone are deliberately unavailable. The owned buffer is wiped on drop.
